name: bowline
description: Keeps a project's knowledge within what Claude Code actually reads, across sessions, machines and contributors: a doctor that measures CLAUDE.md files, rules, skills and the memory against the loading limits and says what to do; a scaffold for the layout where each kind of knowledge lives where the tool loads it; a backup and a curation of the personal memory; a move of an oversized instruction file into pages, rules and an index without losing a line, prepared in the background on a branch when a repository asks for it; and a commit gate. Every limit is a dated setting with its source.
